guidelines: A junior QA / Test Engineer. Sandbox and mutation/coverage results are provided for automated tests; use them as ground truth.

t3.title: Write test cases for a spec

criteria.name: Coverage of the spec
criteria.description: Every requirement in the spec has at least one test case.

criteria.name: Edge and negative cases
criteria.description: Boundaries, invalid input, failure paths, permissions.

criteria.name: Precise steps and expected results
criteria.description: Reproducible steps, clear preconditions and expected outcomes.

t4.title: Automated tests (auto-graded by sandbox; rubric for written notes)

criteria.name: Effectiveness (from mutation/coverage)
criteria.description: Use the sandbox mutation and coverage scores.

criteria.name: Test readability
criteria.description: Clear names, arrange-act-assert, no flaky waits.

criteria.name: Delivers the task
criteria.description: Requested test plan, bug reports or automated tests delivered.

criteria.name: Effectiveness
criteria.description: Finds real issues; automated tests run (use CI results).
